name: Bitsa AI Chatbot – 24/7 AI Sales Assistant, Live Chat & Smart Lead Generation
author: bitsaai

sections.description:
Bitsa AI Chatbot is a next-generation conversational AI assistant designed to turn casual website visitors into loyal customers. Powered by custom large language models, Bitsa AI learns your business inside and out—answering support queries in real time, capturing high-intent leads, and guiding shoppers toward purchasing decisions around the clock.

Unlike traditional static rule-based bots that frustrate visitors with rigid menus, Bitsa AI understands natural human intent, context, and nuance. It answers queries directly from your approved knowledge base (website pages, FAQs, documentation, and product catalogs) with zero hallucinations.

🚀 Key Features

  • Instant Knowledge Base Ingestion: Train your AI in minutes by connecting your website URLs, sitemaps, PDFs, text documents, or FAQs inside your Bitsa AI dashboard.
  • Autonomous Lead Capture & Qualification: Collect visitor names, phone numbers, email addresses, and specific requirements right inside the conversation before handing warm leads to your sales team.
  • Seamless WooCommerce Intelligence: WooCommerce-aware chatbot that helps shoppers discover products, checks stock/details, and allows visitors to add products directly to their cart via the official WooCommerce Store API.
  • True Multilingual & Hinglish Support: Understands and replies naturally in over 50+ languages, including fluent English, Hindi, and natural Hinglish.
  • Asynchronous & Ultra-Lightweight: Loads non-blockingly in your website footer (<15 KB footprint). Guaranteed zero impact on your Core Web Vitals, PageSpeed Insights, or SEO scores.
  • Full Brand Customization: Tailor the chatbot theme, launcher icons, welcome greetings, and chat bubble position directly from your cloud dashboard without touching a single line of code.
  • Multi-Domain Whitelisting & Security: Strict origin verification ensures your chatbot only runs on domains you explicitly authorize.

🛒 Built for E-Commerce & Service Businesses

Whether you run a high-volume WooCommerce store, a digital agency, a healthcare practice, or a real estate consultancy, Bitsa AI acts as your dedicated 24/7 front-desk executive. It resolves up to 80% of repetitive customer support inquiries automatically and routes high-value sales prospects straight into your pipeline.

⚙️ How It Works

This plugin serves as a secure, lightweight connector between your WordPress site and your Bitsa AI cloud dashboard. The AI inference, knowledge base training, and lead management are handled on Bitsa AI’s optimized cloud infrastructure.

A Bitsa AI account is required. Every new account includes an unrestricted 7-day free trial (no credit card required). Affordable paid plans start at just ₹299/month. Explore plans at Bitsa AI Pricing.

External services

This plugin securely connects your WordPress website to the Bitsa AI cloud service to deliver conversational AI and live chat capabilities. No external scripts or styles are loaded until you input and save your authorized Client ID in the plugin settings.

  1. Bitsa AI Embed Widget (www.bitsaai.com)

    • Purpose: Delivers the chat launcher interface and real-time messaging UI to front-end visitors.
    • Script URL: https://www.bitsaai.com/embed-snippet.js
    • Chat Frame URL: https://www.bitsaai.com/embed/
    • Data Transmitted: Your account Client ID, browser technical metadata (standard IP address and user-agent string for session persistence), and visitor chat messages (including name, email, or contact number if voluntarily provided).

  2. Bitsa AI Inference & Orchestration API (production-backend-w1e8.onrender.com)

    • Purpose: Processes incoming user queries against your trained knowledge base, generates conversational responses, and logs captured leads in your dashboard.
    • Data Transmitted: Client ID and chat conversational text.

  3. Local WooCommerce Store API

    • For WooCommerce stores, cart operations requested by visitors are executed directly against your own website’s native REST API (/wp-json/wc/store/v1/). Customer purchase data remains strictly within your WordPress installation.
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.bitsaai.com/privacy/
  • Terms of Service: https://www.bitsaai.com/terms/
sections.installation:
Setting up Bitsa AI Chatbot requires zero coding knowledge and takes less than 2 minutes:

  1. In your WordPress Admin, navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Bitsa AI Chatbot, click Install Now, and then Activate.
  3. Create your free account or log in at Bitsa AI Dashboard.
  4. In the Bitsa AI dashboard, go to Knowledge Base to train your AI on your website content or documents.
  5. Under Domain Access, add your website’s domain name (e.g., example.com without https://).
  6. Navigate to Branding → Embed code and copy your unique Client ID.
  7. In your WordPress admin, click on Bitsa AI Chatbot in the left menu, paste your Client ID, and click Save Changes.

Your intelligent assistant is now live on your site!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account with Bitsa AI to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress frontend to your custom-trained Bitsa AI brain. You can sign up at bitsaai.com in 30 seconds for a full 7-day free trial without entering payment details.

Where do I find my Client ID?

Log in to your Bitsa AI dashboard, go to Branding → Embed code, and copy the Client ID. You can also paste the entire <script> embed snippet into the plugin settings; the plugin will automatically extract your Client ID.

I saved my Client ID, but the chat bubble does not appear. Why?

For enterprise security, Bitsa AI enforces strict domain whitelisting to prevent unauthorized third parties from using your AI quota. Open your Bitsa AI dashboard, click Domain Access, and add your domain (e.g., yourwebsite.com). Whitelisting yourwebsite.com automatically authorizes all subdomains including www.yourwebsite.com.

Can Bitsa AI understand and respond in Hindi or Hinglish?

Yes! Bitsa AI natively supports Hindi, Hinglish (Hindi written in Latin script), and over 50 global languages. It automatically detects the language your visitor uses and responds fluently in that same language.

Can the chatbot help customers on my WooCommerce store?

Absolutely. When active on a WooCommerce store, Bitsa AI can answer product queries, help shoppers find relevant items, and assist with adding items directly to their shopping cart via native WooCommerce endpoints.

Will Bitsa AI slow down my website loading time?

No. The Bitsa AI script loads 100% asynchronously at the bottom of the page footer. It never blocks DOM construction, CSS parsing, or page rendering.

How do I customize the chatbot appearance (colors, avatar, greeting)?

All visual branding is managed centrally inside your Bitsa AI cloud dashboard. Any updates you make to colors, launcher position, welcome messages, or bot avatar reflect instantly on your WordPress site without requiring plugin updates.

Can I temporarily disable the chatbot on my site?

Yes. You can uncheck the “Show chatbot” checkbox on the Bitsa AI Chatbot settings page and click Save Changes, or simply deactivate the plugin.

  • Added asynchronous non-blocking script loader.
